
  ▲ vercel deploy [project-path] [options]

  Deploy your project to Vercel. Use `--temporary` to create a temporary        
  deployment without logging in. The `deploy` command is the default command    
  for the Vercel CLI, and can be omitted (`vc deploy my-app` equals `vc         
  my-app`). Use `--dry` to inspect the detected framework preset and source     
  files without deploying.                                                      

  Options:

       --archive <FORMAT>           Compress the deployment code into an archive     
                                    before uploading it                              
       --build-env <KEY=VALUE>      Specify environment variables during build-time  
                                    (e.g. `--build-env KEY1=value1 --build-env       
                                    KEY2=value2`)                                    
       --create-if-missing          Create the --project if it doesn't exist.        
                                    Required with --yes and in non-interactive mode  
       --dry                        Inspect the detected framework preset and source 
                                    files without uploading or creating a deployment.
                                    Non-TTY output includes every file as JSON       
       --env <KEY=VALUE>            Specify environment variables during run-time    
                                    (e.g. `--env KEY1=value1 --env KEY2=value2`)     
       --environment <ENVIRONMENT>  Environment to deploy to: production, preview, or
                                    a custom environment                             
       --force                      Force a new deployment even if nothing has       
                                    changed                                          
       --guidance                   Receive command suggestions once deployment is   
                                    complete                                         
       --json                       Output as JSON                                   
       --logs                       Print the build logs                             
       --meta <KEY=VALUE>           Specify metadata for the deployment (e.g. `-m    
                                    KEY1=value1 -m KEY2=value2`)                     
       --no-wait                    Don't wait for the deployment to finish          
       --prebuilt                   Use in combination with `vc build`. Deploy an    
                                    existing build                                   
       --prod                       Create a production deployment (shorthand for    
                                    `--environment production`)                      
       --project <NAME_OR_ID>       Project name or ID (default: linked project)     
       --regions <REGION>           Set default regions to enable the deployment on  
       --skip-domain                Disable the automatic promotion (aliasing) of the
                                    relevant domains to a new production deployment. 
                                    You can use `vc promote` to complete the         
                                    domain-assignment process later                  
       --temporary                  Create a temporary deployment without logging in 
       --turbo                      Use a Turbo build machine for this deployment    
       --verify                     Load the deployment URL once it is ready and     
                                    report the status code, size, and page title,    
                                    even with Deployment Protection on               
       --with-cache                 Retain build cache when using "--force"          
  -y,  --yes                        Use default options to skip all prompts          


  Global Options:

       --cwd <DIR>            Sets the current working directory for a single   
                              run of a command                                  
  -d,  --debug                Debug mode (default: off)                         
  -Q,  --global-config <DIR>  Path to the global `.vercel` directory            
  -h,  --help                 Output usage information                          
  -A,  --local-config <FILE>  Path to the local `vercel.json` file              
       --no-color             No color mode (default: off)                      
       --non-interactive      Run without interactive prompts (default: on when 
                              an agent is detected)                             
  -S,  --scope                Set a custom scope                                
  -t,  --token <TOKEN>        Login token                                       
  -v,  --version              Output the version number                         


  Examples:

  - Deploy the current directory

    $ vercel

  - Deploy a single HTML file

    $ vercel ./index.html

  - Deploy a custom path

    $ vercel /usr/src/project

  - Deploy to production and check that the URL loads

    $ vercel deploy --prod --verify

  - Deploy with run-time Environment Variables

    $ vercel --env NODE_ENV=production

  - Deploy with prebuilt outputs

    $ vercel build
    $ vercel deploy --prebuilt

  - Deploy using a Turbo build machine

    $ vercel deploy --turbo

  - Inspect deployment inputs without deploying

    $ vercel deploy --dry

  - Get every deployment file as JSON

    $ vercel deploy --dry --json

  - Write Deployment URL to a file

    $ vercel > deployment-url.txt
